pages.text: $(l)Hydrogen$(), Helium, Neon, and $(l)Helium-3$() rise, while Argon, Krypton, Xenon, and radioactive Radon settle. Their dormant forms are almost invisible. Adjacent redstone or a powered $(l:magnetization:machines/gas_exciter)Gas Exciter$() illuminates each gas in its own discharge colour.

$(l)Tritium$() is different: radioactive decay gives it steady cyan radioluminescence without redstone or FE. Radon exposure accumulates while your head is immersed or while you stand near a Radon-burning Ion Thruster. Leave the cloud to recover. Server owners can disable radiation without disabling Radon as a propellant.
